h: Veekee James sparks debate after moving ₦4m scholarship over winner's reaction
p: Fashion entrepreneur Veekee James has reportedly withdrawn a ₦4 million scholarship from a recipient at a graduation event and given it to someone else, after the winner's flat reaction. The move has divided opinion online.
body: Fashion entrepreneur Veekee James is at the centre of an online debate after she reportedly withdrew a ₦4 million scholarship from one recipient and gave it to another during a live event.

The incident took place on Wednesday, 25 November 2026, at the graduation ceremony of fashion designer Prudent Gabriel's fashion school. James attended with her husband, Femi Atere. When a woman's name was announced as the scholarship winner, she is said to have responded with a reaction many in the room saw as flat and unenthusiastic.
James then intervened and redirected the scholarship to another attendee.
Videos of the moment have sparked debate online about how she handled the situation.
more: It happened at a fashion school graduation.
